_notes.purpose: FastChem emulator tuned for ExoJAX HMC-NUTS retrievals. Training samples abundances in log-uniform so solar (AAS) compositions are well-represented; pressure grid is 1e-7..100 bar to match the standard ExoJAX atmosphere; elemental ranges span ~[-1, +1] dex around AAS.
retrain_log: 2026-04-16 — switched C/O/N/S sampling to log-uniform, set He_H to linear [0.03, 0.18], raised num_runs from 500 to 8000, extended pressure grid down to 1e-7 bar, broadened Teq filter and T_eq analytic range, added dropout 0.05, dropped d_model to 192 for a ~2M-param model that fits the enlarged dataset without overfitting.

Reason: the previous bundle linearly sampled element fractions over 2-3 dex, so AAS solar values landed in the sparse lower-abundance tail. The exogibbs_vs_emulator notebook surfaced the resulting disagreement on H2O and NH3.

2026-04-16 — (TP generation correctness) narrowed analytic_sampler to Mollière+2019 Table 6 extended ~1 decade: log10_gamma [-1,1], log10_delta [-3,1], alpha [0,0.9], log10_p_trans [-2,2], t_int [50,1000], t_eq [300,3500]. Old bounds produced extreme inversions like run_07390 (gamma=27.3). Also clipped the per-run pressure grid to the Roth library's native range [2.4e-6, 170] bar when a PT-library profile is chosen, eliminating PCHIP constant-extrapolation plateaus that were hitting ~65% of Roth runs.

2026-04-16 — (loss) swapped the physical-space loss term from MSE in log10 space to MAE (|log10(pred_VMR / target_VMR)|). Renamed training.loss.lambda_phys -> lambda_log10_mae. Motivation: fractional error is the science-relevant target, and MAE in log-space optimizes median fractional error rather than being dominated by a few low-abundance-tail outliers. Historical mse_log10 values in history.json from older runs are not comparable with the new mae_log10.

2026-04-16 — (accuracy) d_model 192->256, num_layers 4->6, dim_ff 768->1024, activation gelu->silu, dropout 0.1->0.0, added training.ema (decay=0.999) whose shadow weights are used for validation/test/export. No data regeneration; the processed-data contract is unchanged. Prior-architecture checkpoint is not compatible; retrain from scratch.

chemistry_type_options.fastchem: Pure chemical equilibrium via FastChem. Fast (seconds per run). Inputs: T-P profile + elemental abundances.
chemistry_type_options.vulcan: Full VULCAN kinetic-chemistry integration. Slow (minutes-hours per run). Supports vertical mixing, photochemistry, condensation.
